# Owner paths. A PR that changes one passes "Owner OK" only once the owner has
# set the owner-ok label, and a later push that touches one removes the label
# again (docs/plan.md, section 6). The approval workflow reads this file from
# the base branch, so a PR cannot shorten it for itself.
#
# One glob per line, from the repository root: ** spans folders, * and ? stay
# inside one name, and a pattern without a slash matches at the root only.

# The ledger law and money.
db/migrations/**
packages/engine/src/ledger/**
packages/engine/src/money*

# Login.
apps/server/src/modules/auth/**

# The API description, under the MIT licence.
packages/client/openapi.json

# Licences.
**/LICENSE*
LICENSE

# The workflows, these lists and the repository's own checks.
.github/**
scripts/**
**/.protected-name-ok

# The rules for every change.
CLAUDE.md
AGENTS.md
docs/decisions/**
